finding: The deterministic gate checks credential_domain and current_head_sha as caller-supplied strings, and build_production_authorization accepts an arbitrary nonempty authorization_evidence_digest. A caller can therefore present values that look production-authoritative without the gate proving they came from platform-owned authority state.
why_r2_is_not_authority: R2 consensus cannot promote a candidate when a later deterministic/adversarial inspection finds an untested authority-source bypass.
repair_boundary: Production evaluation must consume platform-owned authority registry state for current head, production credential capability, and production authorization issuance. Untrusted caller strings/model/reviewer output must not be accepted as authority inputs. Preserve exact artifact/evidence semantics and all prior failures.
